--- title: "Methods and data" --- ::: {.cell} ::: ## Summary This project combines two open sources into a small, documented database for ten British Columbia stocks. It applies simple written rules to describe each stock's status, its history, and the gaps in the evidence. It is a learning project by an epidemiologist who is new to fisheries science. It does not replicate DFO's methods or those of any seafood recommendation program, and it makes no recommendations. ## Data sources | Source | What it provides | Version | Licence | |:--|:--|:--|:--| | DFO Sustainability Survey for Fisheries | Official status zone (Healthy, Cautious, Critical, Uncertain), reference point descriptions, management plans | 2024 results | Open Government Licence, Canada | | RAM Legacy Stock Assessment Database | Assessment time series (biomass, catch, ratios to MSY) and reference points | v4.66, assessment-only | CC BY 4.0 | | DFO Commercial Seafisheries Landings | Landings by species group, used only as background | 1990 to 2024 | Open Government Licence, Canada | ## Data tiers Stocks differ in how much public evidence exists. Each stock is assigned a tier, and the tier decides which plots and caveats it gets. | Tier | Meaning | Stocks | |:--|:--|:--| | A | Biomass and fishing pressure relative to MSY | Sablefish, Pacific halibut | | B | Biomass relative to MSY only | Pacific cod (5ABCD) | | C | Biomass and catch trends, no MSY ratios | Five Pacific herring areas | | D | DFO status zone only, no assessment time series compiled | Spot prawn, Dungeness crab | ## A common indicator Stocks use different reference points, so they cannot be compared directly. For every stock with a time series, this project divides biomass by that stock's **limit reference point (LRP)**, the level below which DFO considers serious harm to be occurring. A value below 1 means below the limit. The limits are taken or derived from RAM Legacy and are approximate. ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} |Stock |Limit used |Value | |:--------------------------|:---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|:----------| |Sablefish |0.4 x Bmsy (DFO default proxy; the 2024 survey reports this LRP for sablefish) |0.4 × Bmsy | |Pacific halibut |SSBlim from RAM (IPHC limit; the 2024 survey describes the LRP as 0.2 x unfished female spawning biomass) |46,720 t | |Pacific cod (5ABCD) |TBlim from RAM (limit reference point used in the assessment) |9,762 t | |Herring: Strait of Georgia |0.3 x unfished spawning biomass (SSB0 from the 2018 assessment in RAM) |41,638 t | |Herring: WCVI |0.3 x unfished spawning biomass (SSB0 from the 2018 assessment in RAM) |14,067 t | |Herring: Central Coast |0.3 x unfished spawning biomass (SSB0 from the 2018 assessment in RAM) |16,604 t | |Herring: Prince Rupert |0.3 x unfished spawning biomass (SSB0 from the 2018 assessment in RAM) |18,329 t | |Herring: Haida Gwaii |0.3 x unfished spawning biomass (SSB0 from the 2018 assessment in RAM) |6,929 t | ::: ::: ## Cross-checks **Herring limits, RAM versus DFO.** The LRP implied by RAM's 2018 values is compared with the value DFO reported in the 2024 survey, extracted automatically from the survey text. ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} |Stock |RAM: 0.3 x SSB0 (t) |DFO 2024 survey (t) |Difference | |:--------------------------|:-------------------|:-------------------|:----------| |Herring: Strait of Georgia |41,638 |41,547 |0.2% | |Herring: WCVI |14,067 |13,961 |0.8% | |Herring: Central Coast |16,604 |14,854 |11.8% | |Herring: Prince Rupert |18,329 |17,640 |3.9% | |Herring: Haida Gwaii |6,929 |6,347 |9.2% | ::: ::: **Sablefish.** RAM's spawning biomass at MSY (22,820 t) is within 0.5% of the Bmsy reported in DFO's 2024 survey (22,720 t). **Latest indicator versus DFO's 2024 zone.** A stock below its limit should be in the Critical zone; a stock above it should be Cautious or Healthy. ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} |Stock | Latest year|Biomass / LRP |DFO 2024 zone |Consistent | |:--------------------------|-----------:|:-------------|:-------------|:------------------| |Pacific halibut | 2020|1.88 |Healthy |Yes | |Herring: Central Coast | 2018|1.97 |Cautious |Yes | |Herring: Haida Gwaii | 2018|0.65 |Critical |Yes | |Herring: Prince Rupert | 2018|1.36 |Healthy |Yes | |Herring: Strait of Georgia | 2018|3.03 |Healthy |Yes | |Herring: WCVI | 2018|1.45 |Cautious |Yes | |Pacific cod (5ABCD) | 2019|1.61 |Not in survey |No zone to compare | |Sablefish | 2021|2.94 |Healthy |Yes | ::: ::: ## Data dictionary ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ## Downloads - [stocks.csv](data/processed/stocks.csv): one row per stock - [timeseries.csv](data/processed/timeseries.csv): long-format time series, one row per stock, year, and metric - [landings.csv](data/processed/landings.csv): BC commercial landings by species group - [data_dictionary.csv](data/processed/data_dictionary.csv): every field in every table ## How it is built All steps are R scripts in the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/emmabranch/bc-fish-stock-status), run in order: 1. `01_download.R`: downloads the raw files. 2. `04_build_database.R`: builds the tidy tables and data dictionary. 3. `05_herring_stripes.R`: herring biomass stripes for the Explore page. 4. `06_harmonise_lrp.R`: adds the biomass-to-limit indicator and runs the cross-checks. 5. `07_make_figures.R` and `08_map_cards.R`: figures, map, and cards. 6. `09_render_reports.R`: renders one parameterised 2-page PDF per stock. 7. `10_make_site_files.R` and `11_make_banner.R`: stock pages, card styles, and the home page banner. 8. `quarto render`: builds this website. ## Limitations - RAM Legacy copies published assessments, so the time series end between 2018 and 2021 and may not match DFO's latest advice. - Limit reference points used for the common indicator are approximate, and some are derived rather than official. - Point estimates only. Assessment uncertainty is not shown. - Map pins mark general areas, not stock boundaries. - National landings data group several BC species together, so they are not used for stock-level conclusions. - Spot prawn and Dungeness crab have no compiled time series; their status here relies entirely on DFO's survey response. ## References - Fisheries and Oceans Canada (2025). Sustainability Survey for Fisheries, 2024 results. Open Government Portal. - RAM Legacy Stock Assessment Database (2024). Version 4.66. Zenodo. - Ricard, D., Minto, C., Jensen, O.P. and Baum, J.K. (2012). Evaluating the knowledge base and status of commercially exploited marine species with the RAM Legacy Stock Assessment Database. *Fish and Fisheries* 13(4): 380 to 398. - Fisheries and Oceans Canada (2009). A fishery decision-making framework incorporating the precautionary approach.
